SELECT index_id, avail_season, avail_doy, value
FROM climate
WHERE index_id IN ('oni','pdo') AND avail_season=2
ORDER BY avail_doy DESC
LIMIT 6

SELECT fish_date_season, floor(fish_date_doy/10)*10 AS doy_bucket,
       SUM(yt) AS total_yt, SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers,
       SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n_boatdays
FROM trips
WHERE cls='day_1_5' AND fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 220 AND 320
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
